Unke shukraguzar ho jo hamein khush rakhte hain; woh hamari rooh ko khilate hain.
Aazadi discussion, dissent aur debate ke anvil par banti hai.
Azaadi jeetne walon ki saans hai.
Apni umar doston se gino, saalon se nahi. Zindagi muskurahaton se gino, aansuon se nahi.
Khushi apna best dena hai.
Har anand ki jad kritagyata (gratitude) hai.
Khushi farz ka swabhavik phool hai.
Khushi shukr guzaari mein milti hai.
Joy sabse meethi bhavna hai.
Khushi shukraguzari ki pariksha hai.
Azaadi sawal poochne ka haq hai.
Aazadi galat hone ka haq hai, galat karne ka haq nahi.
Passport par stamp nahi, moments collect karo.
Khushmizaji sehat ka phool hai.
Map chhodho, apne dil ki dhadkan follow karo.
Khushi pyari hai.
Anand hi pavitrata hai.
Khushi badi hai.
Aazad hona sirf zanjeerein todna nahi hai...
Khushi function ka byproduct hai.
Azadi ek chunav hai.
Sabse badi aazadi alag tarah se sochne ka haq hai.
Khushi sarvashaktimaan taakat hai.
Khushi abhi mein hai.
Khushi kismat ki nahi, chunav ki baat hai.
Khushi hamesha ke liye hai.
Khushi azaad aatma ka geet hai.
Azaadi sab hai.
